title: Left or right
starting_code:
# Ask with `locked` whether the left door is locked.

# If it is, walk to the right door, open it with `open`, go through and along the corridor.

# Else, do the same by the left door.
hints: We can ask the door if it is locked with `left_door.locked`!
If the left door is locked, walk 3 down and 3 right to `right_door`, open it, walk 3 down and 3 right to the mark.
If it's not locked, `else:`, walk 3 down, 3 left to `left_door`, open it, walk 3 down and 9 right!
intro: Look, a room with two doors! One of them is locked tonight, and there are no keys around. But we can just ask the left door if it is locked! If it is, we will go through the right door, and if it's not, we'll take the left one. The mark is waiting on the right side of the corridor!
outro: You chose perfectly! Asking what things know is a great trick.
learned: Now you know that `if` and `else` can ask what a thing knows, and choose the way by it.
